modules.module_title: Prepare the fabric for inspection and mending

pcs.pc_description: understand the requirements of inspecting the fabric, finding the defects in fabric, marking the defects, following various inspection systems for inspecting and recording the defects
collect the fabric from fabric store area
understand the fabric inspection requirement from the customer
understand the specifications of fabric requirements from the customer
prepare the inspection table for inspection
ensure the inspection table and inspection area is properly illuminated
ensure the proper functioning of continuous fabric inspection machine
mount the fabric rolls on the continuous inspection table / machine
before checking/mending ensure that the equipments used, checking table etc. are clean so that no handling stains are added to the fabric being checked
check whether following required details are written on the cloth rolls, before the same are taken for inspection - loom no, construction details, date & shift of doffing, doffed meters, doffers name
ensure the fabric selvedges are as per requirement
ensure that no transit or handling damage is there on the cloth roll before the same is taken for inspection
get fabric inspection report format with a roll no. duly allotted from the higher authority
reset the counter meter on the inspection machine to zero
mount the fabric roll to be inspected on the cloth roll stands without damaging the fabric
get in writing about the construction details from the higher authority
ensure cleanliness and safety at work place
pull the fabric on the inspection table and inspect the fabrics in manual inspection
operating the inspection machine control switches for moving the fabric on inspection table for inspection
check the dimensions of the fabric
check the following specifications in the sample provided to him/ her
check the following faults with respect to warp and weft

measure the fabric width- remove the wrinkles/ crease gently from the fabric surface by keeping the measuring tape straight across the fabric horizontally from selvedge to selvedge, measure the width as far as possible near the centre avoiding the ends and ensuring not to stretch the to the fabric while measuring

measure the fabric length by passing through meter counter fitted roller or by manually clipping the fabrics in the fold measuring frame or by counting the number of meter fold in case of folded fabrics
note down the fabric specifications as per the construction details
inspect the fabric for the following at 3 places, namely 10 meters from the beginning of the fabric roll, in the middle of the roll and 10 meters before the end of the roll
mend the faults observed in the fabric
check the fabric construction particulars by measuring the EPI, PPI, weight/sq.mtr
ensure using proper tools for measuring the dimensions and construction of fabric
identify the different defects in fabric
identify the defects which come under mendable or non-mendable defects depending upon the magnitude of the defect and the quality of the fabric
remove the fabric defects
ensure the fabric defects are properly mended
support the checker in recording the fabric defects in the visual inspection report
follow the different inspection systems as per the requirement and instructions from superiors
use proper tools and equipments for mending the fabric
Follow tag system for cuttable defects, defects coming under 4 points, and other faults as per the prevalent classification system
ensure all the marked defects are mended
record all fabric defects and mark in the fabric examination report which is / will be mended
mend the loose threads, slubs, snarls and other mendable faults
clean the soft stains using water & brush
note down the defects against the corresponding meter only
Cover and store the inspected fabric properly at the place earmarked
report the defects inspected and mended during the inspection to the higher authority
ensure cleanliness and safety at work place
